```{ojs}
//| echo: false

// Imports
// import * as d3 from "d3"
// import * as Plot from "@observablehq/plot"
import { xySlider } from "@mootari/2d-slider"

// ========= Controls =========
//| panel: input

// Sample size
viewof n = Inputs.range([20, 100], { value: 50, step: 5, label: md`${tex`n`}` })

// True parameters used to SIMULATE the data
viewof trueMu = Inputs.range([-2, 2], { value: 0.5, step: 0.1, label: md`${tex`\mu_{\text{true}}`}` })
viewof trueSigma = Inputs.range([0.3, 3], { value: 1.2, step: 0.1, label: md`${tex`\sigma_{\text{true}}`}` })

// Grid controls
viewof muHalfWidth = Inputs.range([1, 5], { value: 2.5, step: 0.1, label: md`${tex`\text{μ-range half-width}`}` })
viewof sig2Max = Inputs.range([0.2, 6], { value: 3, step: 0.1, label: md`${tex`\text{σ² max}`}` })
viewof gridN = Inputs.range([25, 121], { value: 81, step: 8, label: md`${tex`\text{grid size}`}` })

// ========= Data & stats =========

// Simulate iid Normal data via Box–Muller
X = {
  const m = trueMu, s = trueSigma;
  const out = new Array(n);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i += 2) {
    const u = Math.random(), v = Math.random();
    const R = Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(u)), T = 2 * Math.PI * v;
    const z0 = R * Math.cos(T), z1 = R * Math.sin(T);
    out[i]   = m + s * z0;
    if (i + 1 < n) out[i + 1] = m + s * z1;
  }
  return out;
}

// Sufficient stats
xbar = d3.mean(X)
S = d3.sum(X, x => (x - xbar) ** 2)       // Σ (x_i - x̄)²

// Log-likelihood ℓ(μ,σ²) (exact, not just up to constant)
logLik = (mu, sigma2) => {
  const ss = d3.sum(X, x => (x - mu) ** 2);
  return -0.5 * n * Math.log(2 * Math.PI * sigma2) - 0.5 * ss / sigma2;
}

// MLEs: μ̂ = x̄,  σ̂² = (1/n) Σ (x_i - x̄)²
muhat = xbar
sigma2hat = S / n

// ========= Contour grid =========

muGrid = d3.ticks(muhat - muHalfWidth, muhat + muHalfWidth, gridN - 1)
sig2Grid = d3.ticks(Math.max(0.05, sigma2hat / 20), sig2Max, gridN - 1).filter(s => s > 0)

// Grid for Plot: [{mu, sig2, ll}]
LLgrid = {
  const out = [];
  for (const mu of muGrid) {
    for (const s2 of sig2Grid) {
      out.push({ mu, sig2: s2, ll: logLik(mu, s2) });
    }
  }
  return out;
}

// ========= 2D probe (slider) =========

// NOTE: xySlider may return either [x, y] or {x, y}. We'll read both safely.
viewof probe = xySlider({
  width: 360, height: 360,
  x: { min: muGrid[0],   max: muGrid.at(-1), value: muhat,     label: md`${tex`\mu`}` },
  y: { min: sig2Grid[0], max: sig2Grid.at(-1), value: sigma2hat, label: md`${tex`\sigma^2`}` },
  grid: false
})

// Robust extraction with fallbacks to MLEs (prevents .toFixed errors)
probeMu = (Array.isArray(probe) ? probe[0] : probe?.x) ?? muhat
probeSig2 = (Array.isArray(probe) ? probe[1] : probe?.y) ?? sigma2hat
probeLL = logLik(probeMu, probeSig2)

// ========= Readout =========
md`
${tex`\textbf{Probe: } \mu = ${probeMu.toFixed(2)},\ \sigma^2 = ${probeSig2.toFixed(3)}\quad \Rightarrow\quad \ell = ${probeLL.toFixed(2)}`}
${tex`\textbf{MLE: } \hat\mu = ${muhat.toFixed(2)},\ \hat\sigma^2 = ${sigma2hat.toFixed(3)}`}
`

// ========= Plot =========

md`${tex`\textbf{Log-likelihood contours } \ell(\mu,\sigma^2)\ \text{for Normal}(X_i \stackrel{iid}{\sim} \mathcal N(\mu,\sigma^2))`}`

Plot.plot({
  width: 760,
  height: 460,
  marginLeft: 48,
  x: { label: "μ" },              // SVG text (cannot render KaTeX)
  y: { label: "σ²" },             // (Use md+tex captions like above for maths)
  color: { scheme: "turbo", legend: true, label: "log-likelihood" },
  marks: [
    // Heatmap background (helps orientation)
    Plot.cell(LLgrid, { x: "mu", y: "sig2", fill: "ll", tip: true }),

    // Contours of ℓ(μ,σ²)
    Plot.contour(LLgrid, {
      x: "mu",
      y: "sig2",
      z: "ll",
      thresholds: 10,
      stroke: "currentColor",
      fill: "none"
    }),

    // MLE marker
    Plot.dot([{ mu: muhat, sig2: sigma2hat }], {
      x: "mu", y: "sig2",
      r: 5, stroke: "black", fill: "white",
      title: d => `MLE\nmu=${d.mu.toFixed(2)}\nsig2=${d.sig2.toFixed(3)}`
    }),

    // Probe marker
    Plot.dot([{ mu: probeMu, sig2: probeSig2 }], {
      x: "mu", y: "sig2",
      r: 5, fill: "black",
      title: `Probe\nmu=${probeMu.toFixed(2)}\nsig2=${probeSig2.toFixed(3)}\nlogLik=${probeLL.toFixed(2)}`
    }),

    // Crosshairs at the probe
    Plot.ruleX([probeMu]),
    Plot.ruleY([probeSig2])
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
//| panel: input
//| echo: false

viewof n = Inputs.range([20, 400], { value: 120, step: 20, label: md`${tex`n`}` })
viewof trueMu = Inputs.range([-2, 2], { value: 0.5, step: 0.1, label: md`${tex`\mu_{\text{true}}`}` })
viewof trueSigma = Inputs.range([0.3, 3], { value: 1.2, step: 0.1, label: md`${tex`\sigma_{\text{true}}`}` })
viewof resim = Inputs.button("Resimulate data")

viewof muHalfWidth = Inputs.range([1, 5], { value: 2.5, step: 0.1, label: md`${tex`\text{μ-range half-width}`}` })
viewof sig2Max = Inputs.range([0.2, 6], { value: 3, step: 0.1, label: md`${tex`\text{σ² max}`}` })
viewof gridN = Inputs.range([25, 121], { value: 81, step: 8, label: md`${tex`\text{grid size}`}` })
viewof bins = Inputs.range([10, 60], { value: 24, step: 2, label: md`${tex`\text{histogram bins}`}` })

// ============== Data & stats ==============

X = {
  resim; // re-simulate when button clicked
  const m = trueMu, s = trueSigma;
  const out = new Array(n);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i += 2) {
    const u = Math.random(), v = Math.random();
    const R = Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(u)), T = 2 * Math.PI * v;
    const z0 = R * Math.cos(T), z1 = R * Math.sin(T);
    out[i] = m + s * z0;
    if (i + 1 < n) out[i + 1] = m + s * z1;
  }
  return out;
}

xbar = d3.mean(X)
S = d3.sum(X, x => (x - xbar) ** 2) // Σ (x_i - x̄)²

// Log-likelihood ℓ(μ,σ²)
logLik = (mu, sigma2) => {
  const ss = d3.sum(X, x => (x - mu) ** 2);
  return -0.5 * n * Math.log(2 * Math.PI * sigma2) - 0.5 * ss / sigma2;
}

// MLEs
muhat = xbar
sigma2hat = S / n

// Contour grid
muGrid = d3.ticks(muhat - muHalfWidth, muhat + muHalfWidth, gridN - 1)
sig2Grid = d3.ticks(Math.max(0.05, sigma2hat / 20), sig2Max, gridN - 1).filter(s => s > 0)

LLgrid = {
  const out = [];
  for (const mu of muGrid) for (const s2 of sig2Grid) out.push({ mu, sig2: s2, ll: logLik(mu, s2) });
  return out;
}

// === LEFT PLOT + INTERACTION (single source of truth) ===

// geometry & domains (scalars)
plotW = 540
plotH = 420
marginTop = 20
marginRight = 20
marginBottom = 48
marginLeft = 56
innerW = plotW - marginLeft - marginRight
innerH = plotH - marginTop - marginBottom

muDomain = [muGrid[0], muGrid.at(-1)]
sig2Domain = [sig2Grid[0], sig2Grid.at(-1)]

// Build everything INSIDE the input so it's rendered exactly once
viewof probe = {
  // Make the wrapper act like “inline content”, not a separate input block
  const wrap = html`<div style="display:inline-block; position:relative; width:${plotW}px; height:${plotH}px;"></div>`;
  // This wrapper is the INPUT element; initialise its value
  wrap.value = { x: muhat, y: sigma2hat };

  // Base plot: raster (background) + contours + MLE
  const base = Plot.plot({
    width: plotW,
    height: plotH,
    marginLeft, marginRight, marginTop, marginBottom,
    x: { label: "μ", domain: muDomain },
    y: { label: "σ²", domain: sig2Domain },
    color: { scheme: "turbo", legend: true, label: "log-likelihood" },
    marks: [
      // Heatmap background (prevents white gaps)
      Plot.raster(LLgrid, { x: "mu", y: "sig2", z: "ll" }),

      // Contours over the raster
      Plot.contour(LLgrid, {
        x: "mu", y: "sig2", z: "ll",
        thresholds: 18,
        stroke: "currentColor",
        strokeWidth: 1,
        fill: "none"
      }),

      // MLE marker
      Plot.dot([{ mu: muhat, sig2: sigma2hat }], {
        x: "mu", y: "sig2",
        r: 5, stroke: "black", fill: "white",
        title: d => `MLE\nmu=${d.mu.toFixed(2)}\nsig2=${d.sig2.toFixed(3)}`
      })
    ]
  });
  wrap.append(base);

  // Crosshairs overlay (follows the probe)
  const cross = () =>
    Plot.plot({
      width: plotW, height: plotH,
      marginLeft, marginRight, marginTop, marginBottom,
      x: { domain: muDomain }, y: { domain: sig2Domain },
      marks: [Plot.ruleX([wrap.value.x]), Plot.ruleY([wrap.value.y])]
    });

  let crossEl = cross();
  const crossLayer = html`<div style="position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none;"></div>`;
  crossLayer.append(crossEl);
  wrap.append(crossLayer);

  // Transparent hitbox aligned to inner chart area
  const hit = html`<div style="
    position:absolute;
    left:${marginLeft}px; top:${marginTop}px;
    width:${innerW}px; height:${innerH}px;
    cursor: crosshair; z-index: 10; background: transparent;"></div>`;

  function setFromEvent(evt) {
    const rect = hit.getBoundingClientRect();
    const px = Math.min(Math.max(0, evt.clientX - rect.left), innerW);
    const py = Math.min(Math.max(0, evt.clientY - rect.top), innerH);
    const x = muDomain[0] + (px / innerW) * (muDomain[1] - muDomain[0]);
    const y = sig2Domain[1] - (py / innerH) * (sig2Domain[1] - sig2Domain[0]); // invert y

    wrap.value = { x, y };
    // refresh crosshairs
    const newCross = cross();
    crossLayer.replaceChild(newCross, crossEl);
    crossEl = newCross;

    wrap.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("input", { bubbles: true }));
  }

  let dragging = false;
  hit.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => { dragging = true; setFromEvent(e); hit.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); });
  hit.addEventListener("pointermove", (e) => { if (dragging) setFromEvent(e); });
  hit.addEventListener("pointerup",   () => { dragging = false; });
  hit.addEventListener("pointerleave",() => { dragging = false; });

  wrap.append(hit);

  // Kick one initial update for dependents
  queueMicrotask(() => wrap.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("input", { bubbles: true })));

  return wrap;
}

// Robust extraction
p = probe ?? {x: muhat, y: sigma2hat}
probeMu = (Array.isArray(p) ? p[0] : p.x) ?? muhat
probeSig2 = (Array.isArray(p) ? p[1] : p.y) ?? sigma2hat
probeLL = logLik(probeMu, probeSig2)

// === TWO-PANEL LAYOUT (use ${probe} directly on the left) ===
md`${tex`\textbf{Probe: } \mu = ${probeMu.toFixed(2)},\ \sigma^2 = ${probeSig2.toFixed(3)}\ \Rightarrow\ \ell = ${probeLL.toFixed(2)}`}`

html`<div style="display:flex; gap:20px; align-items:flex-start;">${probe}${rightPanel}</div>`


// ============== Right panel: histogram + Normal pdf ==============

normalPdf = (x, mu, sig2) => {
  return (1 / Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI * sig2)) * Math.exp(-((x - mu) ** 2) / (2 * sig2));
}

xExtent = d3.extent(X)
xPad = 3 * Math.sqrt(probeSig2)
xMin = Math.min(xExtent[0], probeMu - xPad)
xMax = Math.max(xExtent[1], probeMu + xPad)

numPts = 200
xs = d3.range(numPts).map(i => xMin + (i / (numPts - 1)) * (xMax - xMin))

binWidth = (xMax - xMin) / bins
pdfYs = xs.map(x => n * binWidth * normalPdf(x, probeMu, probeSig2)) // area-match curve to histogram counts

rightPanel = Plot.plot({
  width: plotW,
  height: plotH,
  marginLeft: marginLeft,
  marginBottom: marginBottom,
  x: { label: "x", domain: [xMin, xMax] },
  y: { label: "count" },
  marks: [
    Plot.rectY(X, Plot.binX({ y: "count" }, { x: d => d, thresholds: bins, fillOpacity: 0.2 })),
    Plot.line(xs.map((x, i) => ({ x, y: pdfYs[i] })), { x: "x", y: "y", strokeWidth: 2 }),
    Plot.ruleX([probeMu], { stroke: "currentColor", strokeDasharray: "4,3", title: `μ = ${probeMu.toFixed(2)}` })
  ]
})

// ============== Layout + readout ==============

md`${tex`\textbf{Probe: } \mu = ${probeMu.toFixed(2)},\ \sigma^2 = ${probeSig2.toFixed(3)}\quad \Rightarrow\quad \ell = ${probeLL.toFixed(2)}`}`

html`<div style="display:flex; gap:20px; align-items:flex-start;">${leftPanel}${rightPanel}</div>`

md`${tex`\textbf{Tip: } \text{Click or drag on the left plot to move the probe. Use the controls above to resimulate data or change the grid.}`}`
``` 

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// --- Data & stats ---
X = {
  resim;
  const m = trueMu, s = trueSigma;
  const out = new Array(n);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i += 2) {
    const u = Math.random(), v = Math.random();
    const R = Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(u)), T = 2 * Math.PI * v;
    const z0 = R * Math.cos(T), z1 = R * Math.sin(T);
    out[i] = m + s * z0;
    if (i + 1 < n) out[i + 1] = m + s * z1;
  }
  return out;
};

xbar = d3.mean(X);
S = d3.sum(X, x => (x - xbar) ** 2);

logLik = (mu, sigma2) => {
  const ss = d3.sum(X, x => (x - mu) ** 2);
  return -0.5 * n * Math.log(2 * Math.PI * sigma2) - 0.5 * ss / sigma2;
};

muhat = xbar;
sigma2hat = S / n;

// --- Grid for contours ---
muGrid = d3.ticks(muhat - muHalfWidth, muhat + muHalfWidth, gridN);              // ✅ simpler count
sig2Grid = d3.ticks(Math.max(0.05, sigma2hat / 20), sig2Max, gridN).filter(s => s > 0);

LLgrid = {
  const out = [];
  for (const mu of muGrid) for (const s2 of sig2Grid) out.push({ mu, sig2: s2, ll: logLik(mu, s2) });
  return out;

// --- Geometry ---
plotW = 540;
plotH = 420;
marginTop = 20;
marginRight = 20;
marginBottom = 48;
marginLeft = 56;
innerW = plotW - marginLeft - marginRight;
innerH = plotH - marginTop - marginBottom;

// ✅ avoid .at(-1) for compatibility
muDomain = [muGrid[0], muGrid[muGrid.length - 1]];
sig2Domain = [sig2Grid[0], sig2Grid[sig2Grid.length - 1]];

// sizes
nx = muGrid.length;
ny = sig2Grid.length;

// edges so rects abut perfectly
muEdges = {
  const e = new Array(nx + 1);
  for (let i = 0; i < nx - 1; ++i) e[i + 1] = 0.5 * (muGrid[i] + muGrid[i + 1]);
  e[0]  = muGrid[0]    - (e[1] - muGrid[0]);
  e[nx] = muGrid[nx-1] + (muGrid[nx-1] - e[nx-1]);
  return e;
};

sig2Edges = {
  const e = new Array(ny + 1);
  for (let j = 0; j < ny - 1; ++j) e[j + 1] = 0.5 * (sig2Grid[j] + sig2Grid[j + 1]);
  e[0]  = sig2Grid[0]    - (e[1] - sig2Grid[0]);
  e[ny] = sig2Grid[ny-1] + (sig2Grid[ny-1] - e[ny-1]);
  return e;
};

// heatmap cells (never null)
heatCells = {
  const out = [];
  for (let j = 0; j < ny; ++j)
    for (let i = 0; i < nx; ++i)
      out.push({
        x1: muEdges[i],  x2: muEdges[i+1],
        y1: sig2Edges[j], y2: sig2Edges[j+1],
        ll: logLik(muGrid[i], sig2Grid[j])
      });
  return out;
};

// thresholds for contours
llMin = d3.min(heatCells, d => d.ll);
llMax = d3.max(heatCells, d => d.ll);
contourThresholds = d3.ticks(llMin, llMax, 10);

// row-major z array for d3-contour
llValuesRowMajor = {
  const z = new Array(nx * ny);
  for (let j = 0; j < ny; ++j) for (let i = 0; i < nx; ++i)
    z[j * nx + i] = logLik(muGrid[i], sig2Grid[j]);
  return z;
};

// contour polygons in grid coords
contoursGeo = d3.contours()
  .size([nx, ny])
  .thresholds(contourThresholds)(llValuesRowMajor);

leftPanel = {
  const wrap = html`<div style="position:relative; width:${plotW}px; height:${plotH}px;"></div>`;

  // Base plot: NO legend (so the hitbox aligns)
  const base = Plot.plot({
    width: plotW, height: plotH,
    marginLeft: marginLeft, marginRight: marginRight, marginTop: marginTop, marginBottom: marginBottom,
    x: { label: "μ", domain: muDomain },
    y: { label: "σ²", domain: sig2Domain },

      Plot.raster(LLgrd, {width: volcano.width, height: volcano.height})

      // ✅ MLE dot: pass clean x/y data (no transform/x1/y1 confusion)
      Plot.dot([{ x: muhat, y: sigma2hat }], { x: "x", y: "y", r: 5, stroke: "black", fill: "white" })
    ]
  });
  wrap.append(base);

//   // Contours overlay (d3-contour)
//   {

//     wrap.append(svg.node());

//   Crosshairs overlay
  let cross = Plot.plot({
    width: plotW, height: plotH,
    marginLeft, marginRight, marginTop, marginBottom,
    x: { domain: muDomain }, y: { domain: sig2Domain },
    marks: [Plot.ruleX([muhat]), Plot.ruleY([sigma2hat])]
  });
  const crossLayer = html`<div style="position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; background: transparent;"></div>`;
  crossLayer.append(cross);
  wrap.append(crossLayer);

  // Interactive hitbox aligned to inner plotting area
  const hit = html`<div style="
    position:absolute;
    left:${marginLeft}px; top:${marginTop}px;
    width:${innerW}px; height:${innerH}px;
    cursor: crosshair; background: transparent;"></div>`;
  hit.value = { x: muhat, y: sigma2hat };

  function setFromEvent(evt) {
    const r = hit.getBoundingClientRect();
    const px = Math.min(Math.max(0, evt.clientX - r.left), innerW);
    const py = Math.min(Math.max(0, evt.clientY - r.top), innerH);
    const x = muDomain[0] + (px / innerW) * (muDomain[1] - muDomain[0]);
    const y = sig2Domain[1] - (py / innerH) * (sig2Domain[1] - sig2Domain[0]); // invert y
    hit.value = { x, y };

      width: plotW, height: plotH,
      marginLeft, marginRight, marginTop, marginBottom,
      x: { domain: muDomain }, y: { domain: sig2Domain },

    });

    hit.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("input", { bubbles: true }));
  }
  let dragging = false;

  hit.addEventListener("pointermove", (e) => { if (dragging) setFromEvent(e); });
  hit.addEventListener("pointerup",   () => { dragging = false; });
  hit.addEventListener("pointerleave",() => { dragging = false; });

  wrap.append(hit);
  wrap.hit = hit;
  queueMicrotask(() => hit.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("input", { bubbles: true })));

  return wrap;

// Read probe values reactively (no extra visible block)
probeRaw = Generators.input(leftPanel.hit);
probeMu   = (Array.isArray(probeRaw) ? probeRaw[0] : probeRaw?.x) ?? muhat;
probeSig2 = (Array.isArray(probeRaw) ? probeRaw[1] : probeRaw?.y) ?? sigma2hat;
probeLL   = logLik(probeMu, probeSig2);

// --- Right panel ---
normalPdf = (x, mu, sig2) => (1 / Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI * sig2)) * Math.exp(-((x - mu) ** 2) / (2 * sig2));

xExtent = d3.extent(X);
xPad = 3 * Math.sqrt(probeSig2);

// --- Single final layout output (only once; side-by-side) ---
html`<div style="display:flex; gap:20px; align-items:flex-start;">
  ${leftPanel}
``` 
